text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Flowers come in so many varieties, don't they?
...I wonder which one I should choose.

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text:
What can I get you, young lady?
Is this a present for someone?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems something wonderful happened at my mother's work.
So this is to celebrate that.

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text: Well now, what a devoted daughter! Take all the time you need to look around.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Roses, baby's breath, carnations... I wonder what Mother would be most pleased—

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Little lady! Check out the stuff in the back of the shop, too!
If you wanna make your mother happy, you can't compromise, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yes.
I would love to take a look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So engrossed in preparing a gift for her mother,
Air Messiah failed to show up even when training time came.
